mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_site ( site_id, site_code, site_name, domain, default_lang, default_template_id, description, head_meta, copyright, theme, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{siteName}, #{domain}, #{defaultLang}, #{defaultTemplateId}, #{description}, #{headMeta}, #{copyright}, #{theme}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_site SET site_code=#{siteCode}, site_name=#{siteName}, domain=#{domain}, default_lang=#{defaultLang}, default_template_id=#{defaultTemplateId}, description=#{description}, head_meta=#{headMeta}, copyright=#{copyright}, theme=#{theme}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_site SET default_template_id = #{templateId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_site SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_site WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
